title: Preventing Author Profiling through Zero-Shot Multilingual Back-Translation

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the predictability of an author's gender from text (using the Yelp and VerbMobil datasets) via an adversarial BERT-based attribute classifier, evaluating the drop in F1-score to determine how well back-translation obfuscates gender identity.

Evaluating the F1-score of a pre-trained BERT-based classifier in predicting an author's race (African American vs. White based on dialectal variations in the DIAL dataset) to measure how effectively the proposed text transformation prevents racial profiling.
